data.title: PINs with letters get accepted
story: A digital wallet PIN must be exactly 6 characters, all digits. But the PIN "12ab56" is accepted!
Fix the function valid_pin so it checks the PIN's content too, not just its length.
data.solution:
def valid_pin(pin):
    return len(pin) == 6 and pin.isdigit()

explanation: Checking only the length is not enough, because letters and symbols get through. Add pin.isdigit() so a PIN is accepted only when it has 6 characters and all of them are digits.
hints: The code checks only one thing. What else does the PIN rule mention?
Strings have an .isdigit() method that is True when every character is a digit.
